inputs.text: [serious] Herbivore, in a herd. [calm] It ate plants all day long — a huge amount of plants.
[curious] How long could it eat for?
[amazed] Five hundred fifty pounds of plants EVERY day. [proud] As much as you eat in a whole year, in a single day.
[gasps] And did it have enemies, with a neck like that?
[confident] Allosaurus tried, mostly on the young ones. [serious] A full-grown adult wasn't worth the trouble — way too heavy to bring down.
